payload.payload_manifest_algorithm: From custom_components/teslatlas_hub, sort payload-relative file paths using C locale; emit one UTF-8 line '<path-relative-to-this-root> <sha256(file)>\n' per file; SHA-256 the resulting bytes.
excludes: Home Assistant configuration, database, registry, and WAL/SHM files

selectors.install_contract: Require an explicitly selected existing HA config or Container mount; stage only custom_components/teslatlas_hub; refuse overwrite of an existing integration; do not copy tools, tests, virtual environments, fixtures, credentials, or database files.
selectors.remove_contract: Stop the selected HA runtime, preserve a private config backup and exact previous component bytes, remove only this integration payload, and restore the paired backup/component on rollback.
selectors.restart_contract: Use Home Assistant UI Reload for integration-only changes; restart the selected Container after mounted component replacement; never create or start a native HA service.

target.database_and_registry: never owned or modified by the integration staging action

selectors.install_contract: Validate the absolute target, refuse replacement without an exact previous-payload/config backup, and atomically stage/link only the immutable component payload.
selectors.remove_contract: Operator stops HA, restores the paired previous component/config backup, and verifies unrelated config and registry bytes remain unchanged.
selectors.restart_contract: Operator owns the HA restart; the selector does not install a daemon or silently start a runtime.
selectors.acceptance_receipt: Per-run redacted receipt required; no installed acceptance is claimed by this handoff.

runtime.observed: Docker, Compose, Home Assistant, Homebrew, Lima, Colima, and QEMU absent

selectors.blocked_reason: The HA contract permits staging into an explicitly selected existing HA config or HA OS/Container/VM target only; it does not create a native macOS HA service.

artifact.reason: This product does not create or own a native macOS Home Assistant service.

receipt_schema.secret_policy: Never record invitation, bearer, private key, certificate bytes, database password, vehicle identity, or raw response values.
receipt_schema.acceptance_rule: A source payload or static Compose check cannot be promoted to an installed selector receipt without runtime-specific evidence.

hub_action_requested: Bind this HA payload and selector set into the reviewed Hub aggregate manifest/selection receipt. Keep blocked targets explicit and require a fresh runtime receipt before promoting them.
